item.name: Discover command catalogue and validate metadata

exec: const report = findCommand('REPORT'); const mf = findCommand('MOVE_FORWARD'); const mb = findCommand('MOVE_BACKWARD'); const move = findCommand('MOVE'); const stepBack = findCommand('STEP_BACK');

if (report) pm.environment.set('reportCommandId', report.id); if (mf) pm.environment.set('moveForwardCommandId', mf.id); if (mb) pm.environment.set('moveBackwardCommandId', mb.id); if (move) pm.environment.set('moveCommandId', move.id); if (stepBack) pm.environment.set('stepBackCommandId', stepBack.id);

pm.test('MOVE_FORWARD metadata is Continuous + BestEffort + duration', () => { pm.expect(mf, 'MOVE_FORWARD missing').to.not.eql(undefined); pm.expect(mf.executionKind).to.eql('Continuous'); pm.expect(mf.rollbackKind).to.eql('BestEffort'); pm.expect(mf.inverseCommandName).to.eql('MOVE_BACKWARD'); pm.expect(mf.requiresDuration).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('MOVE_BACKWARD exists for inverse', () => pm.expect(mb, 'MOVE_BACKWARD missing').to.not.eql(undefined));

pm.test('MOVE metadata is Grid + Exact when seeded', () => { if (move) { pm.expect(move.executionKind).to.eql('Grid'); pm.expect(move.rollbackKind).to.eql('Exact'); pm.expect(move.inverseCommandName).to.eql('STEP_BACK'); } });

item.name: JobHistory row exists for completed job

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200 && pm.response.text()) { try { jobHistoryPayload = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { console.warn('Could not parse job history JSON:', e); } }
var matchedHistory = jobHistoryItems.find(function(x) { return String(x.jobId) === expectedJobId; }) || jobHistoryItems[0];
pm.test('completed job created/found JobHistory', () => pm.expect(matchedHistory, 'No JobHistory object returned/found').to.not.eql(undefined));

pm.test('history says executed successfully when fields present', () => { if ('executed' in matchedHistory) pm.expect(matchedHistory.executed).to.eql(true); if ('success' in matchedHistory) pm.expect(matchedHistory.success).to.eql(true); });

pm.test('history has command metadata when fields present', () => { if ('executionKind' in matchedHistory) pm.expect(matchedHistory.executionKind).to.eql('Continuous'); if ('rollbackKind' in matchedHistory) pm.expect(matchedHistory.rollbackKind).to.eql('BestEffort'); });
